Meet your coach

Hi, I'm Jovana. I help women train smarter, not longer. I'm a certified personal trainer based in Dubai. My approach combines strength training, sustainable nutrition and habits that fit real life — no crash diets, no endless cardio.

Strength & toning · Fat loss · Glutes & posture · Nutrition coaching

Ways to work together

Personal Training in Dubai

One-on-one sessions in the gym or at your home. Technique, structure and motivation, with me by your side every rep.

Online Coaching

A custom training plan in your app, weekly check-ins and form reviews. Train on your schedule, wherever you are.

Nutrition Coaching

Flexible nutrition built around foods you love. Macros, meal ideas and habits that last beyond the program.
